newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Chernomyrdin to meet Swiss officials during visit.
newsitem.headline: Chernomyrdin to meet Swiss officials during visit.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will hold talks with the Swiss president and foreign minister when he travels to Switzerland this week to attend the World Economic Forum, the Berne government said.

Chernomyrdin will meet President Arnold Koller and Foreign Minister Flavio Cotti in Berne on Thursday to discuss bilateral issues, developments in Russia and European security, a foreign ministry statement said.
He also meets Swiss business executives in Zurich on Wednesday and will attend a Swiss Trade and Industry Association dinner that evening.
The World Economic Forum in Davos is a 26-year-old gathering of world business and political leaders. It runs from January 30 to February 4.
